title: Firmware update
intro: Install a new openKWL version from an update file (.okwl). The unit checks the whole file before anything changes, then restarts by itself to install it.
readyText: The file is checked and stored. It installs when the unit restarts.
askText: The unit checks the whole file first; if anything is wrong, nothing changes. Then it restarts by itself and installs the update: ventilation stops for about {{s}} seconds. Don't switch the unit off meanwhile. You'll need to log in again; settings are kept.
armed: An earlier update is waiting to be installed. Restart the unit to install it, then choose this file again.
